caption: The drawing depicts a single lidded tankard positioned in profile, facing left, and centered within the rectangular composition. The object is rendered in shades of gray and black pencil on an off-white background. The tankard features a cylindrical body with a slightly flared base marked by a series of horizontal grooves. A domed, hinged lid is shown with a small finial at its peak, and the cover is faintly decorated with concentric lines. Attached to the left side of the tankard is a large, ornate handle with a pronounced upward curve and spiral detailing at the ends. The drawing is bordered by a thin, hand-drawn rectangular frame. The lower right corner contains the name "MARALIAN" written in small capital letters. There is a small patch of discoloration at the upper left corner of the paper.
title: Pewter Tankard
